source.check: divisions, names, votes, registers, spoiled papers and percentage polls read from the Irish News's Newry (No. 1) Rural District Council returns (6 June 1936, p. 9)

note: Triennial rural district council election, Newry No. 1 (County Down), fourteen divisions. Polling took place on Thursday 4 June 1936 in the three contested divisions (Carrickcrossan, Rathfriland North, Rathfriland South); four divisions had a single nomination and in seven no nomination was made, the sitting member continuing (Newry Reporter, 7 May 1936, p. 5). Graham, the outgoing member. Both candidates Unionists. 288 (75 per cent) voted, with four spoiled papers.
